question.:question/problem:
Without using a calculator, find the exact value of

$$
6\sin\left(165^{\circ}\right)\cos\left(165^{\circ}\right)
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Use the double-angle formula for sine and keep the multiplier.

Set $x=165^{\circ}$.

$$
\begin{aligned}2\sin x\cos x &=\sin(2x) \\ &=\sin\left(330^{\circ}\right) \\ &=- \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Substitute this exact value:

$$
\begin{aligned}6\sin\left(165^{\circ}\right)\cos\left(165^{\circ}\right)&=3\left(- \frac{1}{2}\right) \\ &=- \frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

generation.domain: Real constant angle; both sine and cosine are nonzero.
